soldier: The head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, labrum yellow, antennae yellow tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered long hairs, the labrum with seven pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base. Head nearly oval, widest at the middle; labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded, the sides slightly arcuate. The left mandible with three marginal teeth and a small pointed projection at the base; the right mandible with two small pointed projections at the base. Postmentum widest at the basal quarter. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about 1.5 times the length of the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly upturned, the anterior margin rather constricted with a small V-shaped median concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.
